faq.question: What courses are available?
faq.answer: We offer courses in programming, data science, web development, and machine learning.

faq.question: How can I enroll to this course?
faq.answer: You have to request support@chatbot.com for enrollment assistance.

faq.question: How long does each course take?
faq.answer: Course duration varies from 4 weeks to 6 months depending on the program.

faq.question: Can I access course materials offline?
faq.answer: Yes, all course materials  or notes can be downloaded for offline access.

faq.question: What is the course fee?
faq.answer: Course fees or cost range from Rs.999 to rs.9999 depending on the course level.

faq.question: Do you offer  payment plans?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer flexible payment plans with 2-3 installments.

faq.question: Is there a refund policy?
faq.answer: Full refund within 14 days of purchase if you haven't completed more than 10% of the course.

faq.question: When is the next exam scheduled?
faq.answer: Exams are held monthly on the last Saturday of each month.

faq.question: How do I register for an exam?
faq.answer: Register through your course dashboard at least 5 days before the exam date.

faq.question: What is the exam format?
faq.answer: Exams consist of 50 multiple-choice questions and 2 essay questions.

faq.question: How do I report a technical issue?
faq.answer: Contact our support team at support@chatbot.com or use the in-app help feature.

faq.question: My certificate hasn't arrived yet. What should I do?
faq.answer: Certificates are issued within 5 business days. Please check your email spam folder or contact support.

faq.question: I can't log into my account. How can I reset my password?
faq.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your email.
